dedupe_keys.name: thaiwater national hydroinformatics data center thailand

description: Thaiwater is the National Hydroinformatics Data Center of Thailand, run by the Hydro-Informatics Institute under the Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation. The portal brings together situation alerts, air quality, storm tracks with history, rain and wave forecasts, a 24-hour rainfall map with station totals, and current temperature, humidity and pressure by region. For water storage it shows the volume and usable volume of the large reservoirs as a share of capacity with critical low and high flags, and tracks the usable water of the four main Chao Phraya dams, Bhumibol, Sirikit, Pasak Jolasid and Khwae Noi Bamrung Daen, against the estimated dry-season demand. It links provincial water data centres, a 3D map system and the ASEAN Hydroinformatics Data Centre, and has a mobile app. Coverage is Thailand. Access is free online through the web portal. Caveats: the footer reserves all rights, no bulk download or API was seen on the home page, and the site is in Thai. Simulation uses: flood and drought warning, reservoir operation and irrigation supply planning. Related records: the NTU Mekong dams database (data-mekong-dams-database-ntu).
